data.description:
Pre-cutover playbook. Single command runs capability probe + forward-compat probe + cursor snapshot to bridge_state/cursor-snapshot.json. Exits 0 only when all three pass.

## Done Definitions
- Single command runs capability + forward-compat + cursor snapshot and exits 0 on success, non-zero with named-step failure ← Satisfies: sc-7
- Forward-compat probe exercises label-write, property-write, JQL-search, property-REST-read on throwaway Jira issue ← Satisfies: sc-7
- Cursor snapshot at bridge_state/cursor-snapshot.json captures both bridge-outbound and bridge-inbound cursors and is committed to the tickets branch ← Satisfies: sc-7

## Considerations
- [Risk] Cursor snapshot must be atomic; partial read must not be written.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
data.title: As a bridge operator, I want pre-cutover requirements (forward-compat probe + cursor snapshot) executable as a single playbook command, so that I have a documented gate before deleting the old bridges.
